Explain the example for carry a value in an action

blocks.text: An action payload carries the information needed for a change. A reducer can use that value to choose the next state.
Use a JavaScript project with @reduxjs/toolkit installed. React examples also need react-redux and React. These imports require your project build tool and are not available in the plain playground.

blocks.title: Carry a value in an action

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `createSlice` groups a state value and its reducer rules. Redux Toolkit also generates an action creator for each named reducer.
`configureStore` creates a Redux store from the supplied reducer or reducer map.
`dispatch` sends an action into the store. Merely making an action object does not update state.

blocks.text: The store becomes 3 because the action payload is 3.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Keep payloads clear and serialisable. Do not put a DOM element or a function in ordinary app state.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Dispatch add with 5 and predict the state.
